oewn-10012375-n.learner: a female child of a parent

examples: "Kitty has no discretion in her coughs," said her father
My father and mother knew nothing of that; they only felt how imprudent a match it must be.

oewn-10127072-n.learner: a person who starts and sets up some institution
examples: He is honoured as the father of the modern hospital.

connotation.why: casts the founder as a revered originator

oewn-10122569-n.learner: the man a family began from

oewn-00019801-r.learner: at every time and on every occasion
examples: "If my children are silly, I must hope to be always sensible of it."

oewn-00020931-r.learner: in every single case, with no change and no exception

oewn-00020219-r.learner: at any time you like, or whatever happens

oewn-01828678-v.learner: to hope for something, to want it, or to prefer to have or do it

oewn-00905166-v.learner: to form a wish in your mind or say one out loud
examples: She shut her eyes and wished before she blew out the candles.

oewn-00905052-v.learner: to ask for something in a polite way, saying what you want

oewn-01555990-a.learner: being a large number of things that can be counted, without saying exactly how large

oewn-02137900-v.learner: to give people the impression of being something or of having some quality

oewn-02139137-v.learner: said of a statement: to look true, likely, or plain

oewn-04936080-n.learner: the manner in which something is done or happens
examples: How pleasant it is to spend an evening in this way!

oewn-05799772-n.learner: doing what you want or choose

oewn-08697710-n.learner: the line that leads to a place or a point

oewn-02567910-v.learner: to get a piece of work finished

oewn-00026390-n.learner: the having of emotions inside you

oewn-05729447-n.learner: something you feel in your body

oewn-00523831-v.learner: to be treated in some stated way
